sample_unit: echocardiography studies with model predictions (of 1541 eligible)
models_evaluated: Aisap.ai deep learning algorithm for mitral and tricuspid regurgitation

links.outcome: Proportion of eligible echocardiograms for which the model could return a prediction
links.effect: Model returned predictions for 578 of 1541 eligible TTEs (38%); performance analysis limited to these cases, indicating mismatch between model input requirements and local acquisition practices.
links.quote: Among 1541 eligible TTEs, the model returned predictions for 578 studies (38%).

links.outcome: Model performance on local historical echocardiograms versus cardiologist reference interpretations
links.effect: MR AUC 0.98 (95% CI 0.97-0.99), 91% accuracy, 95% sensitivity, 89% specificity; TR AUC 0.96, 84% accuracy, 91% sensitivity, 80% specificity; only 38% of studies received predictions.
links.quote: For MR, the model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.98 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.97-0.99], with 91% accuracy, 95% sensitivity, and 89% specificity.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation of an AI tool for echocardiographic diagnosis of atrioventricular regurgitation severity without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
